blocks.text: Picking up John Macias's note, I have the first set of executive messages for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} in draft and will have it to you by the end of the week. It follows the frame from the kickoff, so it should read in the company's own voice rather than ours.

On the audience question John raised, my instinct is to lead with the investor view and let the internal story follow from it, but I would rather have your read before the wording sets. The two are close enough here that a short conversation would likely settle it.
For the file, final sign-off on the Suarez-Jones messaging stays with you, Jennifer Herrera. Send the draft back with anything marked and I will turn it the same day.
